deviations.why: Works the same on Docker Desktop and on a CI runner; only the database and Redis hosts differ.

deviations.why: The maintainer removed django-compressor and the compress step.

concerns: The T006 blocker is resolved by D11: the compress step and django-compressor are gone, and the smoke test passes against the unmodified demo image.

Smoke test environment the production portal needs: DJANGO_SECRET_KEY (50+ chars), DJANGO_SITE_DOMAIN, POSTGRES_HOST, POSTGRES_PORT, POSTGRES_DB, POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, REDIS_URL (fairdm.E200 refuses the placeholder cache), plus X-Forwarded-Proto: https on requests. The guide lists them.
Celery logs 'ready.' only at INFO, so the smoke test starts the worker with `worker --loglevel INFO --concurrency 1`, which also exercises argument pass-through.

Seen once in the migrate output inside the demo image, not investigated: a message ending "Run 'manage.py makemigrations' to make new migrations, and then re-run 'manage.py migrate'". It may mean a model change without a migration.
